purpose: Teach: コピペ/うんこ/メイル/クリエーター/できよ/チョー/シャラ/コットン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「学校の宿題でコピペはダメよ」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying you shouldn't just copy-paste your homework.
lines.style: Gentle, observational tone. Soft opening. Warm reminder without lecturing. Speaking from remembered conversation, not correction. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと「うんこドリル」で漢字練習したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I practiced kanji with Dad using the Unko drill.
lines.style: Bright, eager delivery. Quick pace, not rushed. The pride of small accomplishment. Wanting her to know he did the work. Open, genuine excitement without showing off.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「先生にメイル、つまりメールを送る」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying you should send an email to your teacher.
lines.style: Same observational warmth as before. Gentle translation of his phrasing. Not urgency — just passing along. Slight pause around the clarification, like she's remembering his exact words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと若いクリエーターの展示観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I went to see a young artist exhibition with Dad.
lines.style: Quick, eager to share. Still warm but with the energy of something he wants her to know happened. Not seeking approval — just including her. Natural child's pace.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが古風な口調で「お代わりできよ」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying in his old-fashioned way that you could have seconds.
lines.style: Gentle amusement underneath. Warm affection for his speech patterns. Reflective, like she's noticing and treasuring these small quirks. Soft, approving tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「チョー楽しい体験」って言葉教わったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad taught me this cool phrase — 'super fun experience.'
lines.style: Earnest and direct. Genuinely pleased to have learned something. The care of sharing a new word. Not performative — just straightforward kid honesty. Small pride in the phrase itself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがテニス選手のシャラポワのドキュメンタリー観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is watching a documentary about the tennis player Sharapova.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact observation. Like sharing something small she noticed. No particular judgment — just passing it along. Quiet, natural delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんからコットンの肌着を頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad gave me some cotton undershirts.
lines.style: Warm, satisfied. The comfort of being cared for. Simple statement with genuine appreciation underneath. Close, intimate tone — sharing something small but meaningful. A gentle smile.
